seed: The panel's group headings on a video, at Next defaults with nothing switched on by hand, as video.html draws .dgrp-h: a small capital title, a chip right beside it saying what the group holds, and the group's own button at the far edge. Properties says Clip and ends in a three dot menu, Effects counts its effects and has a plus, Library says its scope and has a plus.

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: the recording picked. The Properties heading reads PROPERTIES in small capitals with a Clip chip right beside it and three dots at the far edge; no heading carries a grip
THE SECOND TEST: the Properties menu's Copy Look takes the clip's look, and the canvas says so
THE THIRD TEST: two effects added with the plus on the Effects heading, and its chip says 2

steps.comment: View > Library, the way a person turns the shelf on: the Library waits to be asked for.

steps.note: THE FOURTH TEST: with the groups above folded away the headings stack as the mock draws them: PROPERTIES Clip, EFFECTS 2 with a plus, and, once View > Library has asked for it, LIBRARY Media with a plus
